sweep.criterion: stable iff all losses finite, final < 0.5*first, last-20% mean < 0.5*first-20% mean, max <= 1.5*first, and least-squares slope < 0; select the stable LR with the lowest late-window mean (ties: lower LR)

repeat.sentinel_scratch: unavailable: two-pass scratch is private and has no public poison hook

limitations: full-parameter raw gradient tensors are not exposed; per-step gradient norms are recorded only for LoRA
full-parameter exact checkpoint resume is not implemented and is refused
two-pass scratch has no public sentinel/poison hook; sentinel contamination is not claimed
memory, scratch-byte overhead and checkpoint-export timing are not measured
the sweep and convergence measure training loss, not held-out generalization
